newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash gains and oils rise with Chicago.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash gains and oils rise with Chicago.

text.p: Argentine cash gain and oilseed prices rose on month-end technical factors in busier trade on the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange Monday, with gains in Chicago helping the advance, dealers said.

With gains of about $3 a tonne in Chicago especially for soybeans and maize, inspired by forecasts of another hot, dry spell in the U.S. Midwest, Argentine wheat showed gains of around $2 a tonne and maize was $3 higher.
Sunseed was $1 firmer in Quequen and Rosario, while soybeans showed sharp gains in Buenos Aires, up $6.
